name: Fazbear's Revamp P1 CLASSIC
desc:
This is the old version of Fazbear's Revamp P1! We're working on a new, overhauled version of the game. We'll be leaving this old version up under a new name, but you can find the new game down below!
NEW GAME: https://www.roblox.com/games/11255641834/Fazbears-Revamp-ALPHA

This roleplay game is our own take on the Five Nights at Freddy's series! We're not aiming to be accurate to the original FNAF games, just our own take on things.
